title.narrative: Infrastructure Implementation for the Socio-Educational Care Infrastructure of the Government of Brazil

description.narrative: UNOPS manages the works of three socio-educational units in different parts of Brazil, to strengthen infrastructure of the National Socio-Educational Service System and contribute to the reduction of the unemployment with the creation of at least 250 new posts, generating practical and tangible models for applicability of knowledge transfer to state technicians.
